basic_details.scholarship_name: TU Wien & Vienna Applied Data Science Excellence Grants
basic_details.offering_entity: TU Wien (Vienna University of Technology, Austria) & Faculty of Informatics
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: TU Wien (Karlsplatz Main Campus, Vienna, Austria)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open to all Master's and PhD programs within the Faculty of Informatics and Engineering: Data Science, Logic & Computation, Computer Engineering, Visual Computing, Media & Human-Centered Computing, Medical Informatics, Software Engineering & Internet Computing, Electrical & Computer Engineering, Mechanical, and Chemical Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~15 to 25 merit grants, departmental tuition reimbursements, and research assistantships awarded annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; strong representation among Pakistani CS and data science graduates (typically 3 to 6 awardees/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master of Science (120 ECTS) or up to 3-4 years for PhD candidates

nationality_requirements: Open to international students from non-EU/EEA third countries
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) in Computer Science, Data Science, Software Engineering, Mathematics, or closely related engineering field with outstanding academic record (minimum 3.70 / 4.00 CGPA or 80%+ aggregate from recognized Pakistani universities like NUST, FAST-NUCES, LUMS, QAU, UET, GIKI, PIEAS).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Equivalence to Austrian academic grade 'Sehr Gut' (Grade 1.0 to 1.5 on Austrian 1.0-5.0 scale).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial mathematical preparation (Linear Algebra, Probability & Statistics, Discrete Mathematics) and verified programming proficiency in Python/C++.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently enrolled in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Competitive programming (ACM-ICPC), GitHub portfolio, open-source projects, and research papers significantly enhance competitive standing.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic minimum 7.0 overall or TOEFL iBT min 95 (subscores 20+).

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: German not required for English-taught Faculty of Informatics Master's and PhD programs; German A1/A2 beneficial for daily living.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite graduate students in Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, and Computer Engineering.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot concurrently hold Austrian OeAD full scholarship.

tuition_fee.details: Austrian public university tuition fee for third-country nationals is only €726.72/semester (plus €22.70 student union fee), which is waived or reimbursed for excellence grant holders.
tuition_fee.amount: 100% covered (~€1,453 / year; minimal public tuition in Austria)

admission_application_fee.details: TU Wien charges no application fee for regular degree admissions.

accommodation.details: Covered via monthly excellence stipend; OeAD student housing or private student dormitories in Vienna (~€400 to €600/month).

monthly_stipend.details: Excellence grant living allowance of €800 to €1,000 / month (~PKR 245,000 to 305,000 / month; €9,600 to €12,000 / year). PhD research assistants receive standard FWF contract salary (~€2,400/month gross).

airfare.details: Travel expenses to Vienna are self-funded by the student.

visa_fee.details: Austrian Residence Permit (Aufenthaltsbewilligung - Student) application fee (€160) paid by candidate to Austrian Embassy.

health_insurance.details: Austrian public student health insurance (ÖGK Selbstversicherung für Studierende) costs ~€69/month, covered directly from the monthly living stipend.

food_allowance.details: Living and meal expenses covered by monthly stipend.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: TU Wien Informatics provides modern lab workstations, supercomputing access (VSC - Vienna Scientific Cluster), and course resources.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research groups fund travel to top-tier international conferences (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, VLDB) for students with accepted papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Vienna public transit semester ticket (Wiener Linien Semesterticket, ~€75/semester for students under 26) paid by student.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution (TU Wien, Vienna, Austria - QS World Rank #190, Top 100 in Computer Science)
participating_institutions: TU Wien (Faculty of Informatics, Karlsplatz / Favoritenstrasse Campus, Vienna)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Austria's largest technological university; Ranked #66 in Europe for Engineering & Computer Science, world-renowned for Logic, Data Science, and Formal Methods.
available_majors: Data Science (Machine Learning, Big Data Analytics, Statistical Computing)
Logic and Computation (Automated Reasoning, Formal Verification)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: Master of Science: 4 semesters (120 ECTS / 2 years); PhD: 3 to 4 years.
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Accredited Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Informatics with strong mathematical foundation, minimum 3.7+ CGPA, comprehensive curriculum match, academic CV, and English proficiency.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Data Science and Logic & Computation have very demanding mathematical prerequisite reviews; Software Engineering has slightly broader entry evaluation.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Check the TU Wien Informatics curriculum prerequisite matrix carefully. Non-EU applicants must submit applications early (before 5 February for winter semester) due to Austrian embassy legalisation processing timelines in Islamabad.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: TU Wien TISS Campus Portal & Admissions Office
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register an account on TU Wien TISS portal, complete the online application for admission to the Master's in Data Science/Informatics, and upload required documents.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Verify curriculum equivalence against the TU Wien Master's in Data Science curriculum guide.
Step 2: Create an account on the TU Wien TISS student portal.
Step 3: Fill in the online admission application form for your chosen Master's program.
Step 4: Upload attested academic transcripts, degree certificates, detailed syllabus description, and CV.
Step 5: In the departmental funding section, indicate application for the Faculty Excellence Grant / Assistantship.
Step 6: Submit the online application before the non-EU admission deadline (5 February for Winter semester).
Step 7: The Faculty Study Commission reviews academic equivalence and issues an Admission Letter (Zulassungsbescheid).
Step 8: Faculty departmental board reviews excellence grant candidates and selects awardees.
Step 9: Grant notification sent via email; candidate receives official funding confirmation letter.
Step 10: Apply for Austrian Student Residence Permit at the Austrian Embassy in Islamabad and finalize enrollment in Vienna.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Combined admission and faculty funding consideration: admitted students with top rankings are nominated for excellence grants and research assistantships.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Two academic recommendation letters uploaded directly to the TISS application portal.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Academic Purpose (max 2 pages) detailing mathematical competencies, software projects, and proposed master's thesis research direction.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Brief outline of research interests in data science, machine learning, or algorithms.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Europass or clean academic CV highlighting programming competencies, GitHub repositories, competitive programming ranks, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Short technical video interview (20-30 minutes via Zoom) conducted by the Faculty of Informatics for shortlisted candidates to evaluate coding and mathematical concepts.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic (7.0+) or TOEFL iBT (95+). GRE General (Quantitative 162+) strongly recommended.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Austrian embassy legalisation (super-legalisation) required for Pakistani educational certificates (HEC -> MOFA -> Austrian Embassy Islamabad).
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified German or English translations for all non-English/German documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via TU Wien TISS portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Clear color copy of valid international passport data page.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Ensure name spelling matches educational records.

required_documents_checklist.document_name: Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificate
required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts of 4-year Bachelor's degree showing courses, credit hours, and grades.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must be attested by HEC, MOFA, and super-legalised by Austrian Embassy in Islamabad.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official syllabus descriptions of all mathematics and computer science courses taken in undergraduate degree.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Crucial for establishing equivalence to TU Wien Bachelor in Informatics.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1 to 2 page statement describing technical interests in data science, computing, and research ambitions.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Highlight specific research labs at TU Wien you wish to join.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Academic CV detailing programming languages, machine learning frameworks, GitHub projects, and rankings.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Include links to open-source contributions or technical project repositories.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Signed recommendation letters on university letterhead from professors of computer science or mathematics.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must include referee institutional email addresses and phone numbers.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official IELTS Academic (7.0+) or TOEFL iBT (95+) test report.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Test score must be valid at semester commencement.

important_dates_timeline.application_deadline: 5 February (Strict non-EU deadline for Winter semester entry in October)
important_dates_timeline.interview_period: March - April (technical interviews for shortlisted candidates)
important_dates_timeline.visa_application_window: May - August (Austrian residence permit processing in Islamabad takes 3 to 4 months)
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Main intake starts in October (Winter semester). Due to lengthy Austrian embassy legalisation and visa times, early submission by January is strongly recommended.

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 45% (Coursework grades, Bachelor's CGPA, and specific grades in mathematics/algorithms)
selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 25% (Technical portfolio, thesis quality, GitHub code, publications)
selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry software engineering or data science experience)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Technical statement of purpose and research alignment)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: Decisive factor during technical interviews (evaluates coding and mathematical competence)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty of Informatics Study Commission and principal investigators from data science research groups.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: The Study Commission rigorously reviews the mathematical and algorithmic depth of the undergraduate curriculum. Candidates who meet the equivalence threshold are ranked based on CGPA and technical portfolio. Shortlisted applicants undergo a technical interview, and top-tier candidates receive excellence grants or paid research assistantships.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~1,800 to 2,200 international applicants apply to TU Wien Informatics programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~15 to 25 merit grants and funded research positions awarded annually
competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~3% (High success rate for top-tier graduates of FAST, NUST, LUMS, GIKI with strong coding/math skills)
competitiveness_profile.typical_successful_applicant_gpa: 3.75+ / 4.00 CGPA (82%+ aggregate, strong grades in calculus, linear algebra, and data structures)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Computer Science graduates with solid theoretical foundations, substantial programming capability (Python/C++), and demonstrable research or software projects.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates in Data Science, Computer Science, Software Engineering, and Electrical Engineering.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Iran, Turkey, Ukraine, Serbia, China.

fake_websites_and_scams: Agencies claiming they can bypass Austrian legalisation or guarantee admission to TU Wien. TU Wien operates strictly through direct institutional admission.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: TU Wien charges ZERO application fee. Any website demanding application processing fees is fraudulent.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Do not pay agents. The legalisation process in Pakistan must be handled personally by the candidate through HEC, MOFA, and the Austrian Embassy.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Austrian Embassy legalisation in Islamabad is expensive (~PKR 40,000 - 60,000 per document attested).
Austrian student residence permit application fee (€160).
Living expenses in Vienna are moderate (~€850 - €1,000/month), but students must show proof of ~€12,000 funds in a bank account for visa issuance.
Flight tickets between Pakistan and Vienna (~PKR 180,000 - 250,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: CLAIM: German language proficiency is required for admission. (FACT: Master's in Data Science and Logic & Computation are taught 100% in English).
CLAIM: You can legalise documents after arrival in Austria. (FACT: Super-legalised documents MUST be submitted before admission is finalized).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites cite tuition fees of €1,500/semester; Austrian public university statutory tuition is officially €726.72/semester for third-country students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must complete at least 16 ECTS credits per semester with satisfactory academic standing to retain grant funding.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research and course attendance on TU Wien campus in Vienna.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester credit check conducted by the Faculty of Informatics.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Non-EU students in Austria may work up to 20 hours per week (requires an employment permit - Beschäftigungsbewilligung issued by AMS).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None. Austria provides a 12-month post-graduation 'Red-White-Red Card' job search visa.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding terminated upon failure to meet credit thresholds; no clawback of disbursed stipends.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Requires approval from the Study Commission.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Granted for maximum 4 semesters for Master's; extensions require special justification.
